reviewMethod: Each commit subject and ownership-signal summary was reviewed in original chronological order. Ambiguous or mechanically mixed rows were checked against the original name-status change set, and semantically ambiguous package/application rows were checked against their original patch or file content. These overrides correct path-location signals that do not describe the change's actual ownership.

classificationRationales.OWLAPI_PACKAGE: The change is wholly owned by the standalone owlapi implementation, its package tests, reference tooling, conformance evidence, or continuing package documentation.
classificationRationales.WEBVOWL_INTEGRATION: The change belongs to WebVOWL ontology ingestion, VOWL conversion, application output, corpus/reference integration, or another non-visual application seam; its path location does not make it package-owned or UI/UX work.
classificationRationales.WEBVOWL_UI_UX: The change alters WebVOWL's user-visible interface, interaction, accessibility, editing experience, visual assets, or UI-specific tests and belongs on the reconstructed UI/UX lineage.
classificationRationales.SHARED_BUILD_OR_DEPENDENCY: The change is repository-wide build, dependency, lint, formatting, test-runner, or licence infrastructure rather than a semantic package or UI capability.
classificationRationales.UNRELATED: The change is useful WebVOWL repository history but is outside the owlapi package, application integration, UI/UX, and shared build/dependency partitions.
classificationRationales.MIXED_REQUIRES_SPLIT: The original commit combines package-owned changes with WebVOWL-only integration, root configuration, or other application-owned changes and therefore requires a reviewed package/non-package split.
